description: This file contains JavaScript code for managing a dynamic, AJAX-loaded tree structure with drag-and-drop support, context menus, and state persistence, used in the TestLink project for features like test specification and test plan management.

classes.name: TreePanelState
classes.description: A class managing the state (expanded/collapsed nodes) of the tree, including saving/restoring state and context menu handling.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the state by loading from local storage.

methods.name: saveState
methods.description: Saves the current tree state to local storage.

methods.name: onExpand
methods.description: Updates state when a node is expanded.

methods.name: onCollapse
methods.description: Updates state when a node is collapsed.

methods.name: restoreState
methods.description: Restores the tree to the last saved state or defaults.

methods.name: menuShow
methods.description: Displays context menu based on node type.
